sn45.48:0.3: The Abandoning of the Fetters, Etc.
sn45.48:1.2: “Bhikkhus, if wanderers of other sects ask you:
sn45.48:1.3: ‘For what purpose, friends, is the holy life lived under the ascetic Gotama?’—being asked thus, you should answer them thus:
sn45.48:1.4: ‘It is, friends, for the abandoning of the fetters … for the uprooting of the underlying tendencies … for the full understanding of the course … for the destruction of the taints … for the realization of the fruit of true knowledge and liberation … for the sake of knowledge and vision … … for the sake of final Nibbāna without clinging that the holy life is lived under the Blessed One.’
sn45.48:1.5: “Then, bhikkhus, if the wanderers of other sects ask you:
sn45.48:1.6: ‘But, friends, is there a path, is there a way for attaining final Nibbāna without clinging?’—being asked thus, you should answer them thus:
sn45.48:1.7: ‘There is a path, friends, there is a way for attaining final Nibbāna without clinging.’
sn45.48:1.8: “And what, bhikkhus, is that path, what is that way for attaining final Nibbāna without clinging?
sn45.48:1.9: It is this Noble Eightfold Path; that is,
sn45.48:1.11: This is the path, this is the way for attaining final Nibbāna without clinging.
sn45.48:1.12: “Being asked thus, bhikkhus, you should answer those wanderers of other sects in such a way.”
